schema: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE stage_orders(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER); CREATE TABLE lines(line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE VIEW classified AS SELECT o.*, CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'null_key' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id=o.customer_id) THEN 'known' ELSE 'unknown' END AS key_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id) AS line_count FROM stage_orders o; CREATE TABLE accepted(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE quarantined(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE rejected(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL);

accept_predicates.reject-batch: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classified WHERE key_state='unknown')

classification: SELECT order_id, key_state, line_count FROM classified ORDER BY order_id
metric_ids: SELECT c.order_id FROM classified c JOIN accepted a ON a.order_id=c.order_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=c.order_id) ORDER BY c.order_id
metric: SELECT SUM(c.amount),COUNT(*),COUNT(c.amount),COUNT(*)-COUNT(c.amount) FROM classified c JOIN accepted a ON a.order_id=c.order_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=c.order_id)
fk_schema: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE fk_orders(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(customer_id), amount INTEGER);
